caption: The drawing features a single smoking pipe, centrally positioned within a rectangular border on a plain, off-white background. The pipe has a long, straight stem colored in brown, leading to a slightly thicker junction where it meets the bowl. The bowl is wider and curves downward, also rendered in shades of brown, with subtle lines suggesting texture or wood grain. The interior of the bowl appears dark, indicating depth. The overall composition is minimal, with the pipe being the only object depicted, and the artist's signature, "Manuel G. Runyan," is present at the lower right corner outside the rectangular border.
title: Clay Pipe
